answer: Hand the panel a pulse it can verify, a vertex it can count, and a nectar it can date, and the panel will do the rest. Raising one clone takes 99 POA and 31 minutes; keeping 759 of them alive costs 75141 POA and 23529 minutes every epoch. What divides an agent from a mask is Brick carrier glaze pot warrant fired in the brick oven, and the division is each glaze pot is a year of kiln logs in the firing ledger. The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is checked against an open register.
